hero.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba — Infinity Castle (Chapter I)
hero.format: Theatrical film, first of the three-part Infinity Castle finale
hero.about: Chapter I of the Infinity Castle finale — Muzan drags the Demon Slayer Corps into his labyrinthine stronghold for the endgame confrontation. Picks up right after the Hashira Training Arc. Ufotable's biggest theatrical event to date; ~$794M worldwide box office before this streaming drop.
hero.why: Tier-1 hero this week: Loved-list continuation (Demon Slayer) AND on your watchlist — the perfect double-hit. Streams TOMORROW Tue 7/28 at 8:00 AM PT worldwide on Crunchyroll with Japanese audio + English dub + 14 other language dubs. If you'd rather own it, same-day digital rental/purchase on Apple TV, Prime Video, Google Play, YouTube, and Fandango at Home. Supernatural + fantasy + Ufotable animation + book-to-anime adaptation = four of your top signals_what_lands. This has been the pinned watchlist item for months — Tuesday is the payoff.
hero.priority_reason: Loved-list continuation (Demon Slayer) + watchlist item, released Tue 7/28 on a platform you have (Crunchyroll). Beats every taste-extrapolated pick this week per hero selection priority order.

new_this_week.title: Hannibal — Seasons 1–3 (Complete)
new_this_week.about: Bryan Fuller's Mads Mikkelsen / Hugh Dancy adaptation of Thomas Harris's novels — Will Graham and Dr. Hannibal Lecter's mind-game descent. Left Netflix years ago; all three seasons return worldwide 7/27.

Novel adaptation + great acting + dark tone + 42-min episodes = four direct hits on signals_what_lands. Multi-week binge locker on a platform you already pay for.
